title: LSP Not Establishing Between PE Routers
symptoms: IGP routes exist between all PEs and P routers
LDP sessions between some routers are missing
MPLS forwarding table is incomplete on one PE
rootCause: LDP is not enabled on all core-facing interfaces. The 'mpls ip' command must be on every interface along the LSP path. One P router has LDP disabled on its core-facing interface, breaking the LSP.

steps.prompt: Which command shows LDP neighbor sessions and their state?
steps.hint: All core-facing neighbors should show 'Operational' state.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the MPLS forwarding table (LFIB)?
steps.hint: Labels for customer prefixes should be present with valid next-hops.

steps.prompt: Which command shows whether MPLS is enabled on a specific interface?
steps.hint: Every core-facing interface must show 'Yes' for LDP.
